selection.target_episode_rule: highest available episode id selected from metadata and carrier identities before target tactile loading
selection.source_episode_rule: all other carrier-complete episodes of the same physical object

shared_preprocessing.robot_tactile_alignment: monotone common-endpoint resampling of released legacy robot and raw tactile carriers

kernel_candidates.distance: mean standardized squared state distance plus action_distance_scale times mean standardized squared future-action distance
kernel_candidates.weighting: softmax over negative selected-neighbor distance divided by its positive median

model_averaging.weights: generalized-Bayes weights from leave-one-source-episode-out active-field RMSE

uncertainty.calibration: leave-one-source-episode-out model-average residuals with donor-only mean correction and a source-fitted scalar covariance multiplier

statistics.relation_breaking_control: permute target future-action features while preserving target tactile prefixes and all source-fitted parameters

claim_boundary: Retrospective same-object cross-action tactile-response development evidence. The nonlinear candidate was frozen before the predecessor ridge target result became available. A positive result motivates separately locked reserved-object or 3-D confirmation; it is not itself an ICRA paper claim, strict counterfactual validation, dense 4-D geometry validation, or state-of-the-art evidence.
